text:
Estimated by item:

| Item | Weight (g) | Energy (kcal) |
|---|---|---|
| Roast beef with herbs | ~90 | ~180 |
| Chicken pieces | ~70 | ~120 |
| Roasted potatoes, oiled | ~80 | ~120 |
| Cauliflower | ~180 | ~50 (plus ~20 if buttered) |
| Fried patty (fish cake or veggie) | ~60 | ~140 |

Totals come to about 480 g and about 630 kcal, which I rounded to the figures below.

```json
{"kcal": 620, "mass_g": 480}
```
